ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Felix eats 2 carrots each day, so group the carrots by day: day 1 covers carrots 1–2, day 2 covers carrots 3–4, day 3 covers carrots 5–6, day 4 covers carrots 7–8, day 5 covers carrots 9–10, and day 6 covers carrots 11–12. The 12th carrot is eaten on Wednesday, so day 6 is Wednesday. Counting back five days from Wednesday gives: day 5 Tuesday, day 4 Monday, day 3 Sunday, day 2 Saturday, day 1 Friday. Therefore, Felix started eating the carrots on Friday.
